name: slider
useFor: Use to set a number in a known range where the rough value matters more than the exact one (a per-order budget, a retry count). Show the current value beside it in the platform mono. Pass two values for a range, and set step for whole units.
constraints: A slider for an exact amount the user must type
source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the switch key and the speed bars in speed.feature)
title: Slider
description: A 4px rule filled with the blue up to the value, with a small white key you drag or step with the arrow keys.
